source_issue.title: Improve drag & drop support in the blocks engine

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on improving the drag and drop capabilities in the Volto blocks engine. The proposal aims to replace the current `react-beautiful-dnd` library with `react-aria`, which is actively maintained and offers better flexibility.

## What needs to be done
Contributors will need to:
- Refactor the drag and drop infrastructure using `react-aria`.
- Enable moving blocks between the main blocks stream and various block containers.
- Create a new `DragDropList` component while deprecating the old one.
- Improve animations and collision detection for a better user experience.
- Address potential breaking changes related to existing components.

## Helpful background
Moving to `react-aria` is crucial as the current library is no longer actively developed, which limits our implementation. The existing system also has limitations related to context isolation, making it difficult for components to interact properly.

## Good first steps
Begin by reviewing the [Proof of Concept Pull Request](https://github.com/plone/volto/pull/3547) to understand the ongoing work. Familiarize yourself with the current drag and drop logic in the [DragDropList component](https://github.com/plone/volto/blob/master/src/components/manage/DragDropList/DragDropList.jsx). Engaging with the discussion in this issue may also provide valuable insights.
```
